title: Carb, insulin button missing
body:
While they were there this morning, the Carb, Insulin and bolus calculator dissapered since then.
It did occur after I stopped insulin delivery completely on the Pump (Dana-i). The Buttons reappeared a while (10-20 min.) after starting insulin delivery.
The same thing happened when changing the reservoir jus now, so I suspect that might be the reason, althought I am not certain. 
The buttons are activated in the settings.
Build Nr. 1de236a602-2023.06.03-15:45
Version 3.1.0.3 fullrelease
